audit_items.proof_trace: The precompile calls external NuGet package Secp256r1.VerifySignature without try-catch protection (L30). If the library throws on any input (e.g., extreme sizes, malformed data), the VM exception handler (VirtualMachine.cs:1021-1026) catches it and returns shouldRevert=true, violating the never-revert property. Tests cover common invalid inputs, but no defensive programming guards against library exceptions.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker constructs pathological input (e.g., extremely large byte array) that triggers an exception in the Secp256r1.VerifySignature library implementation. The VM catch handler intercepts the exception and reverts the transaction instead of returning empty output.
